reduced_motion.label: Reduce decorative motion
reduced_motion.description: Stop decorative waves and page transitions while keeping controls responsive.

panel_width.label: Sidebar width
panel_width.description: Logical pixels for the sidebar surface. 450 matches the approved reference.

remember_last_tab.label: Remember the last tab
remember_last_tab.description: Reopen the sidebar on the tab you used last.

default_tab.label: Starting tab
default_tab.description: Tab used when the sidebar does not remember the last one.

timer_default_minutes.label: Default countdown length
timer_default_minutes.description: Minutes offered when the countdown is idle.

timer_presets.label: Countdown presets
timer_presets.description: Quick lengths in minutes, e.g. 5, 15, 25, 60. Invalid entries are dropped.

confirm_window_close.label: Ask before closing a window
confirm_window_close.description: Show a confirmation card instead of closing a window immediately.

hotspot_default_ssid.label: Default hotspot name
hotspot_default_ssid.description: Prefilled in the hotspot form when the saved name is unknown.

hotspot_default_band.label: Default hotspot band
hotspot_default_band.description: Band preselected when the hotspot is off.

system_refresh_seconds.label: Status refresh interval
system_refresh_seconds.description: Seconds between hotspot and window status queries while those pages are open.
